pro_course_detail.description:

This class is for those who have already completed a written document and would like to have it checked by a professional with experience in business and academic writing. However, the rules of this lesson type are a bit different.

If you do not see your document type listed below, message me with your details (what type of writing), and I will see if it is possible after reviewing. 

*Document Types Accepted* 
Statement of Purpose (SOP)
Letter of Recommendation (LOR)
Business Plan / White Paper / Executive Summary / Internal Documents / In-house company stylizations. 
Academic papers (APA, MLA, LaTeX, CMOS, Harvard Style, etc.)
Developmental Editing (Manuscripts, e-book formatting for publication, such as InDesign, InCopy, Vellum, etc.)
Dissertation & Theses review (formatting to in-house style and citation checking). 

Remember: Editing classes are paid by word or project and are quoted after I have seen your material. I do not do live editing in these classes; you are paying for the document to be corrected and sent back. No meeting will take place.

If you believe you need to meet before, book a 30-minute class and message that we need to discuss your project before I can begin editing. This is likely for developmental editing (manuscript editing) but rarely necessary for academic corrections other than dissertations or theses.

pro_course_detail.description:
➡️THIS IS MY SPECIALTY! ⬅️

I will give you an IELTS mock speaking exam using the current questions and will give you an IELTS Band score and evaluation.

Please choose the 45-minute lesson. I am required by iTalki to offer a 60-minute lesson, but I don't want you to choose it. That's why it's so much more expensive than my 45-minute lesson. I want to be able to have a short break between classes. 

45-Minute Mock Exam Lesson: The lesson will follow this format: 1) I will get some information from you; 2) I'll give you the mock exam using the current questions. 3) I'll tell you your speaking score for all four areas and the total speaking score; 4) I'll tell you what you need to do to improve; 5) We'll have some time at the end for me to point out some of the mistakes you made. 6) There is always time for you to ask me questions. 

Please choose a time that starts on the hour (for example: 8:00) and not a time that starts on the half hour.

PLEASE NOTE that I don't usually use the video function when I teach. I don't need to see you, only hear you. I prefer to teach using my phone, which I hold in my hand and sometimes put down on my desk. I don't want to make you feel like you are on a boat in the ocean when I'm giving you a lesson! The only time I use the video is if you insist that you need to see me so that it feels more like a real exam. If this is your situation, please let me know in advance so I can be prepared. 

If you are from China I will send you a message asking you to add me on WeChat. I prefer using WeChat with Chinese students. If you are not from China I prefer to use the iTalki classroom.

Please choose a time that starts on the hour (for example: 8:00) and not a time that starts on the half hour.

I accept students for IELTS preparation who need to make a Band 6.5 or higher.

Here's the bad news: I only accept students who I think I can help! For example, if you have serious grammar or pronunciation problems, you need a teacher who is better in those areas than I am. Yes, I can find the problems (I have a very good ear, since I was an IELTS examiner), but I'm not good at correcting them. More bad news: I only accept students who have already had one of my mock exam lessons. That way I know what your band score is and if I am the right person to help you reach your goal score.

Please choose the 45-minute lesson or 90-minute lesson. I am required by iTalki to offer a 60-minute lesson, but I don't want you to choose it. That's why it's so much more expensive than my 45-minute lesson. I want to be able to have a short break between classes. For the first 45 minutes I will give you a mock exam and evaluation. We'll take about a ten-minute break, then come back and have an IELTS preparation lesson. In this lesson I'll focus on the weak areas that I found when I gave you a mock exam. 

I normally only accept IELTS preparation students who need a Band 6.5 or higher, but for this Combo Lesson, I'll accept anyone. 

iTalki requires their teachers to offer a 60-minute lesson; however, I can't do a mock exam and prep lesson in only an hour. Please don't choose the 60-minute lesson, only the 90-minute one.

Maybe you want to learn American idioms and slang or share photos of a family event or recent vacation. Perhaps you have a YouTube channel and you need help writing or practicing your script. Whatever it is, let's make it FUN AND CASUAL!

      or content.
